tasks.label: Rust: test workspace
tasks.detail: Unit tests plus the generation tests, which decode the rendered PNG with a real QR decoder. No 1C licence needed.

tasks.label: Rust: render a sample code
tasks.detail: Writes build/qr-code.png so the result can be looked at. Arguments go after --.

tasks.label: Native: build component (both targets, size config)
tasks.detail: Nightly, size-first: -Z build-std with optimize_for_size and immediate-abort.

tasks.label: 1C: build extension (CFE with the binary template)
tasks.detail: Packing separately is not needed: the script stages the tree, creates build/ib and compiles.

tasks.label: 1C: build merge carrier (CF, no qr_ prefix)
tasks.detail: The same objects as a plain configuration, for the configurator's compare-and-merge with a main configuration.

tasks.label: 1C: build the extension and its test suite (no licence)
tasks.detail: Tier 1 of tests/bsl/run-tests.sh: packs, stages, registers the suite and compiles with ibcmd.

tasks.label: 1C: assemble the handoff set
tasks.detail: Archive, compiled extension, both module texts and the consumer guide, into build/handoff.

tasks.label: 1C: activate licence (open the infobase interactively)
tasks.detail: One-off. The licence lands in ~/.1cv8, which is a named volume.
